goal: Prepare up to 25 exact unpublished hotels, then publish up to 10 ready full hotel posts in both authorized channels through the existing bounded publisher.
boundaries: No customers, advertisement campaigns, old publication replay, video recovery, owner hotel import or new runtime service. This phase only reads the selected public catalogue/registry and prepares existing templates.
criteria: Exact unique active catalogue objects and absent target-channel publications.
Ready full human captions and authentic accepted branded covers for each selected hotel.
A live batch is accepted only after 2*N actual photo/body/button/source receipts.
risks: Main9c5be changed four pinned publishing service blobs and the incoming adapter for MAX videos. Image/Telegram paths are unchanged in the reviewed diff; update only exact reviewed service pins and preserve original runtime guards.
The first TLS attempt stopped before installation of9c5be; after completed deploy, rerun only that failed gate if no existing rerun is active.
Some new resort photos may be renders or future opening material; omit unready hotels rather than inventing readiness or holding the other hotels.
